metadata.title: Retro Arcade Rhythm Game Soundtrack Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, multi-layered graphic composition featuring stacked 3D titles, a central horizon line with radial light bursts, and a background pattern of repeating directional arrows. The aesthetic is defined by vibrant lime greens, deep blues, and metallic golds, evoking early 2000s arcade culture.
coreVisualRelationships: Stacked vertical hierarchy of three distinct typographic blocks
Central horizontal band of white light separating top and bottom sections
Repeating arrow motif in the background creating a sense of motion
Contrast between flat vector silhouettes and heavy 3D extruded text
coreInvariants: Lime green and purple layered outlines for the top title
Metallic gold 3D extrusion for the bottom title
Radial firework bursts behind the lower subject
Dark blue background with a grid-like pattern of directional icons

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large title blocks dominate the upper and lower thirds, with a secondary subtitle strip in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white light burst acts as the horizontal axis for the entire composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left title, down through the central white band, to the bottom-right silhouette and metallic title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with patterns, light effects, and layered text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and royal blue background with cyan light effects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant lime green and yellow for the primary title outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and orange firework bursts for warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high contrast, with bright neon elements against a dark, textured background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif with heavy italicization
letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion with perspective towards a central vanishing point
Multiple concentric outlines in contrasting neon colors
Integrated star shapes within letter counters
Sheared and slanted angles to imply speed
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'R' feature sharp, lightning-bolt-like terminals
The 'i' dot replaced by a five-pointed star
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hyper-stylized 3D display type paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square-geometric feel of the secondary text.
Necessary for the primary display title's aggressive angles and layering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark navy background with a subtle repeating pattern of cyan directional arrows. Add a bright white horizontal radial light burst across the center. In the bottom half, place several colorful firework-style radial bursts in orange and yellow, and a green female silhouette in a dynamic dance pose on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stacked 3D title in the top half with lime green faces and purple/green layered outlines. Add a wide-tracked, yellow geometric sans-serif subtitle across the central light band. Add a metallic gold 3D title in the bottom half with heavy perspective.

verificationChecks: Ensure neon outlines are vibrant and distinct
Verify wide letter spacing on the central subtitle
Confirm the arrow pattern is visible but not distracting

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central light burst
Density of the background arrow pattern
postGenerationChecks: Is the 3D text legible despite the heavy effects?
Does the central light band effectively divide the composition?
Are the neon colors sufficiently saturated?
Is the background pattern consistent across the frame?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 3D geometric display type with neon multi-layer outlines over a dark, patterned background featuring radial light bursts and silhouettes to create a high-energy arcade aesthetic.
